summary: Indian benchmark indices opened on a mixed note today as gains in select banking stocks were offset by weakness in IT and auto shares. UBS reiterated a positive outlook on HDFC Bank, driving interest in the financial sector despite broader market caution. Investors remain vigilant regarding global trade developments, oil price movements, and central bank policy trends.
